messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: realtime-streaming.p99 latency exceeded threshold in eu-west-1 (p99=1.2s > 0.9s). Alert ID: abcd-1234. Triggered at 2026-03-17 15:04:21 UTC. Paging oncall: @oncall-mike. Link: https://grafana/redwood/d/streams/p99?orgId=1&from=now-15m
oncall-mike: Acked. I'm on it. Jumping into dashboards. Can someone post any recent deploys to eu-west?
samir: No deploys in last 30m from infra. We did push a config change to routing rules 45m ago (config-id: route-evict-42).
anya: Grafana shows a tight tail at ~15:03. Prefetch/kv-hit dropped to 46% around same time. https://grafana/redwood/d/kvcache/overview
oncall-mike: Good catch. Can we check redis/kvcache errors? @luca can you pull tail logs from streaming-proxy pods?
luca: tail logs from streaming-proxy (last 5m):
```
2026-03-17T15:02:50Z WARN kvcache: miss for prefix abc123
2026-03-17T15:03:01Z ERROR proxy: downstream write timeout 500ms
2026-03-17T15:03:10Z INFO routing: route-evict-42 applied
```
Looks correlated.
oncall-mike: Ok. Initial hypothesis: routing change caused increased cache misses -> backend pressure -> p99 up. Quick mitigations: 1) rollback routing change, 2) enable emergency burst capacity, 3) route small % to fallback model variant. Which is fastest?
samir: Rollback route-evict-42 is small config flip, can push immediately. I'll prepare revert.
anya: I can flip fallback routing to serve 10% to variant-b (lower mem, higher latency but consistent).
oncall-mike: Do both. Samir revert now, Anya set variant ramp to 10%. Also increase streaming pool min instances by 2.
samir: Revert pushed: route-evict-42 -> disabled. Deploy logs: `deploy 1759000001-route-revert ok` :white_check_mark: 
anya: Variant ramp done: `ramp variant-b to 10%` :white_check_mark: scaling request to autoscaler for +2 instances submitted.
infra-bot: Autoscaler: scaling up streaming-pool-eu-west by 2 replicas (requested by anya). Estimated ready in ~60s.
oncall-mike: Monitoring... p99 dropping on the dashboard. kv hit climbing back to 78%. Good sign. Keep watching for 10m.
luca: No customer-facing errors in logs, only internal timeouts. No 5xx spiking.
oncall-mike: Thanks. Leaving page open for follow-up. Next steps: run postmortem checklist, add regression test for route config, and schedule a rollback-proofing runbook. I'll tag incident owner for writeup.
oncall-mike: :thumbsup: Closing incident page if metrics stay stable for 15m. Update last message.
